title: TraceSpec
description:
The merged verb's optional ``--spec``: a mode-discriminated projection.

The bare lineage query takes no spec (``--campaign-id`` / ``--run-id``
args only); ``mode: render`` / ``mode: diff`` select the data-trace
projections. Emitted as ``trace.input.json``.

KeyTolerance.description:
Per-key tolerance override (mirrors verify-reproduction's ``KeyTolerance``).

Both bounds optional; an absent bound is simply not applied. When BOTH are
absent the key is compared EXACTLY — same as supplying no tolerance at all.

abs_tol.description: Absolute tolerance: |a - b| <= abs_tol is not a divergence.
abs_tol.title: Abs Tol

rel_tol.description: Relative tolerance: |a - b| / max(|a|, |b|) <= rel_tol is not a divergence.
rel_tol.title: Rel Tol

KeyTolerance.title: per-key trace tolerance

TraceDiffProjection.description: The diff mode's spec: :class:`TraceDiffSpec` plus the discriminator.

a.description: The A-side trace key (e.g. today / this arm / the canary).

b.description: The B-side trace key (e.g. last-known-good / the other arm / the local run).

tolerance.description: Caller-owned tolerance; None (or all-absent) → exact comparison.

TraceDiffProjection.title: trace-diff input spec

TraceKey.description:
A point-lookup key into the local trace store (one task's records).

``task`` defaults to ``0`` — a single-task local run stores under ``task-0``
(the T1 recorded-answer), and most reference/canary comparisons are of one
task, so the caller rarely supplies it.

scope_id.description: The scope id (run_id / audit_id / cmd_sha12 for a local run).
scope_id.title: Scope Id

task.description: The task index within the scope (single-task local runs use 0).
task.title: Task

TraceKey.title: trace-diff store key

TraceRenderProjection.description: The render mode's spec: :class:`TraceRenderSpec` plus the discriminator.

scope_kind.description: Trace store scope kind for the DIRECT point lookup (with scope_id).
scope_kind.title: Scope Kind

scope_id.description: Trace store scope id for the DIRECT point lookup (with scope_kind).
scope_id.title: Scope Id

task.title: Task

cmd_sha.description: REFERENCE lookup: newest run matching this cmd_sha (Class B).

markdown.description: Include the code-rendered markdown views in the result.
markdown.title: Markdown

TraceRenderProjection.title: trace-render input spec

TraceTolerance.description:
Caller-owned tolerance for the tolerance-class atom comparisons.

All fields optional. When every field is absent (and ``per_key`` empty) the
comparison is EXACT — the no-invented-tolerance rule (core never picks an
epsilon; the caller supplies the ReproTolerance posture or gets exact). A
default bound applies to every numeric field lacking a ``per_key`` override;
a ``per_key`` entry fully replaces the default for that key.

Key convention: ``"duration_ms"`` / ``"peak_mb"`` for the scalar-cost atoms,
``"value_sketch:<column>"`` for a per-column sketch. Only the tolerance-class
atoms consult it — exact / set-delta / exact-per-key / equality-chain /
exact-endpoints atoms are ALWAYS compared exactly.

default_abs_tol.description: Absolute tolerance applied to every numeric field lacking a per_key override.
default_abs_tol.title: Default Abs Tol

default_rel_tol.description: Relative tolerance applied to every numeric field lacking a per_key override.
default_rel_tol.title: Default Rel Tol

TraceTolerance.title: trace-diff tolerance spec
